create_leetspeak_augmenter: create a LeetSpeak augmenter with aug_min, aug_max, aug_p, and granularity parameters
encode_text_to_leetspeak: encode a string to leetspeak by substituting letters with numbers and symbols
augment_text_with_leetspeak_all: augment an entire text string to leetspeak using granularity set to all
augment_text_with_leetspeak_word: augment selected words in text to leetspeak using granularity set to word
augment_text_with_leetspeak_char: augment selected characters in text to leetspeak using granularity set to char
